summary: Recovered the authoritative served request contract without sending audio. Live Supabase metadata proves study-transcribe-v1 ACTIVE v7 with verify_jwt=false and digest 06e3fb..., while served source proves the authenticated class route is POST multipart/form-data with audio plus session_id/room_token application-level room validation. The standalone branch is explicitly excluded from authenticated-class acceptance. A sanitized receipt contract and Served-vs-repository-source separation were persisted.

tests.name: served_identity
tests.evidence: Live function metadata reports ACTIVE v7, digest 06e3fb..., verify_jwt=false.

tests.name: authenticated_class_shape
tests.evidence: Served source requires POST multipart form with audio and validates session_id + room_token against study_class_sessions.

tests.name: gateway_auth
tests.evidence: Live metadata explicitly reports verify_jwt=false; Authorization/apikey are not required by the Supabase gateway for this deployment.

tests.name: standalone_separation
tests.evidence: mode=standalone uses client_session_id and does not execute roomOK, therefore it is not authenticated class transcription.

tests.name: privacy_guard
tests.evidence: No audio, transcript, session id, room token or credential was sent/read/persisted by this archaeology run.

unresolved: Authenticated private-audio E2E acceptance itself remains unrun and requires an authorized ephemeral audio sample plus valid room credentials; those sensitive inputs must remain outside durable Prometeo evidence.
